name: 35th Avenue Sew & Vac
old_description: We pride ourselves on providing the highest quality of customer service.
about:
35th Avenue Sew & Vac is a family-owned retailer of sewing machines, vacuums, and fabrics based in Chandler, Arizona, with additional locations in Phoenix and El Mirage. The company has served the Phoenix metropolitan area for approximately 40 years and is now operated by the second generation of the founding family.

The company operates three retail stores and an event center, with its flagship Phoenix location spanning 24,000 square feet and stocking roughly 20,000 bolts of fabric alongside dozens of sewing machine models. As an authorized dealer, it carries machines and accessories from brands such as Baby Lock, Bernina, Elna, Handi Quilter, Husqvarna Viking, Juki, and Pfaff, as well as vacuums from Beam, Bissell, Miele, Riccar, and others. In addition to sales, 35th Avenue provides longarm quilting services for customer quilts and runs a full-service repair shop capable of servicing nearly any brand of sewing machine or vacuum.

Its customer base includes quilting and sewing hobbyists, embroidery enthusiasts, and homeowners seeking vacuum solutions, with the company shipping orders nationwide through its e-commerce site.

The business emphasizes high-quality customer service and positions itself as a one-stop shop for quilting, sewing, and embroidery needs.
